title: The VMM must protect wireless access to the system using authentication of users and/or devices.
check_content:
Verify the VMM protects wireless access to the system using authentication of users and/or devices.

If it does not, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the VMM to protect wireless access to the system using authentication of users and/or devices.
VulnDiscussion:
Allowing devices and users to connect to the system without first authenticating them allows untrusted access and can lead to a compromise or attack.

Wireless technologies include, for example, microwave, packet radio (UHF/VHF), 802.11x, and Bluetooth. Wireless networks use authentication protocols (e.g., EAP/TLS, PEAP), which provide credential protection and mutual authentication.

This requirement applies to those VMMs that control wireless devices.
